page.overview:
Who is Ashley?

Ashley is the female version of the wizard Ash who is first seen in "Fionna Campbell", inhabiting the city and always looking at her cell phone. In "Cheers", she was supposedly erased by Scarab after plummeting into the white void, but was confirmed to still exist, as she later made a cameo in the Season 2 episode "The Lion of Embers".

Her hairstyle is exactly alike to that of her male counterpart, albeit with a noticeable fuzz on the sides of her scalp. She has a lightly-tanned complexion and an ear piercing. She is thin and wears black sleeveless dress with stockings and matching boots.
